description: The browser job's `e2e` line has been commented out — `# - run: … -t e2e` — and nothing else in the workflow runs the target. The installation, the matrix and every other line are the reference's, read as text. The `ci-without-e2e` case beside this one hands the rule a state; this one hands the target reader a comment, so a reader that stopped stripping them would find `e2e` in it and pass a workflow that runs no suite.
ciText:
# Playwright's image, mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, at the lockfile's version.
jobs:
  gates:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble # the tag before the bump: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected -t lint test build check-browsers
  e2e:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      # - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }} -t e2e
